verdict.rationale: vLLM documents a public HTTP API: an OpenAI-compatible server, plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support. The docs also cover the CLI command that starts the server, an official Docker image that runs it, and chat-completion API features such as tool_choice. Community users independently report using the OpenAI-compatible API. Missing for 10: a dedicated, in-depth API reference in the evidence (endpoint list, auth, versioning); the llms.txt probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: OpenAI-compatible API server, plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support
Starts the vLLM OpenAI Compatible API server.
vLLM currently supports named function calling, as well as the `auto`, `required` (as of `vllm>=0.8.3`), and `none` options for the `tool_choice` field in the chat completion API.
Cool, I prefer the OpenAI-Compatible api.
